responsibility: Defines the RL78 machine-description patterns for the backend’s intermediate ‘virtual instruction’ layer, where operations are expressed using virtual registers and synthetic v.* mnemonics prior to the RL78 devirtualization/reorg pass. It provides match patterns and valloc attributes for moves, arithmetic, extensions, shifts, calls, compares, and selected peepholes, giving the custom allocator/devirt machinery a structured instruction vocabulary that can later be rewritten into real RL78 instructions in rl78-real.md.
